Excellent. Here's the full landscape and where we can draw inspiration.

---

## What These Tools Do (That's Interesting)

### [TBC Audit](https://www.tbc-audit.com/) — "Top 100 Benchmarking"
- **Core concept**: Compares your DPS against the **Top 100 players** for each boss, per spec
- Focused and opinionated — it's purely a "how do I stack up" tool

### [ParseForge](https://github.com/alexandermayes/parseforge) — "Actionable Feedback Engine"
- **Percentile breakdowns** per boss per spec
- **Talent comparison** against top-ranked players
- **Rotation analysis** — compares your cast sequence to what top players do
- **Personal history** — DPS/percentile/score **deltas between runs** (improvement tracking over time)
- **Missing enchant detection** and gear gap analysis vs top performers

### [TBC Duck Analyzer](https://github.com/patitokun03-spec/TBC-Duck-Analyzer) — "Raid Leader's Audit Dashboard"
- **Interactive buff/debuff timelines** — visual timeline of Sunder Armor, Scorch, Judgement uptimes on bosses
- **Interrupt tracking** — per-player interrupt counts
- **Log comparison** — side-by-side diff of two raid logs, two players, or two classes
- **Gear Inspector** — inspect exact gear/enchants/gems from the log data
- **SQLite caching** to avoid API rate limits (we already do this)

---

## What We Already Have vs. Inspiration Gaps

| Feature Area | Us | Them | Gap? |
|---|---|---|---|
| Consumable tracking | Yes (detailed) | Yes | Covered |
| Gear/enchant/gem inspection | Yes (via character profile) | Yes | Covered |
| Role-based analysis | Yes (healer/tank/DPS) | Partial | **We're ahead** |
| Buff/debuff uptime timelines | No | Duck Analyzer | **Gap** |
| Interrupt tracking | No | Duck Analyzer | **Gap** |
| Top-100 / percentile benchmarking | No | TBC Audit + ParseForge | **Gap** |
| Rotation / cast sequence analysis | No | ParseForge | **Gap** |
| Talent comparison vs top players | No | ParseForge | **Gap** |
| Log-to-log comparison (side-by-side) | Partial (Compare view) | Duck Analyzer | **Partial gap** |
| Personal improvement deltas over time | Partial (trend charts) | ParseForge | **Partial gap** |
| Raid-wide performance board | Yes (encounter perf) | ParseForge | Covered |
| Cross-raid aggregate stats | Yes | No | **We're ahead** |
| GM/RL insight dashboards | Yes (charts, heatmaps) | No | **We're ahead** |
| Reference report comparison | Yes | No | **We're ahead** |
| Markdown/CSV export | Yes | No | **We're ahead** |

---

## Top Inspiration Picks (Most Impactful for Us)

1. **Buff/debuff uptime timelines** — Visual timeline bars showing key debuff uptimes (Sunder, Scorch, CoE, Judgements) per boss fight. This is the kind of thing a raid leader looks at instantly to see who's slacking on raid-critical debuffs.

2. **Interrupt tracking** — Simple per-player interrupt count per fight. Easy to pull from our existing cast data, high value for raid leaders.

3. **Percentile benchmarking** — Comparing player DPS against WarcraftLogs rankings (we already pull zone rankings and encounter rankings in our character profile — we could surface this more prominently as a "how do you stack up" score card).

4. **Personal improvement deltas** — ParseForge's "score deltas between runs" is slick. We have trend charts already, but explicit "+12% DPS since last week" callouts would be more impactful.

5. **Log-to-log diff** — Duck Analyzer's side-by-side comparison of two raid nights. We have Compare for characters, but a "this week vs last week" raid-level diff would be powerful for the GM/RL view.

Want me to plan out any of these as a feature addition? The interrupt tracking and buff timeline would probably be the quickest wins since we already pull the underlying event data.

- [TBC Audit](https://www.tbc-audit.com/)
- [ParseForge](https://parseforge.gg/) ([GitHub](https://github.com/alexandermayes/parseforge))
- [TBC Duck Analyzer](https://tbc-duck-analyzer.com/) ([GitHub](https://github.com/patitokun03-spec/TBC-Duck-Analyzer))
- [wowaudit](https://wowaudit.com/)

Agent {"description":"Design implementation plan","subagent_type":"Plan","prompt":"Design an implementation plan for adding "Duck Analyzer"-inspired features to the WarcraftLogs project at D:\code\warcraftlogs_project. These features are: **buff/debuff uptime timelines**, **interrupt tracking**, and **log-to-log comparison**.

## Current Architecture Summary

### API Client (warcraftlogs_client/client.py)
- `get_buffs_table(report_id, source_id)` returns `{data: {auras: [{guid, name, totalUses, bands: [{startTime, endTime}]}]}}` for friendly buffs
- `get_cast_events_paginated(report_id, source_id)` returns all cast events for a player
- `get_fights(report_id)` returns fight list with `{id, name, startTime, endTime, kill, encounterID}`
- `get_aura_data(report_id, source_id)` fetches buff events
- No methods exist for `dataType: Debuffs` or `hostilityType: Enemies`
- The WCL GraphQL API supports `dataType: Debuffs`, `hostilityType: Enemies`, and `abilityID` filters

### Analysis Engine (warcraftlogs_client/analysis.py)
- `analyze_raid()` orchestrates all analysis, calls sub-functions, returns `RaidAnalysis`
- `_analyze_consumables()` is the closest pattern — fetches buffs table + cast events per player, matches against consumes_config.json, returns ConsumableUsage objects
- Config-driven approach: consumes_config.json maps spell_id strings to display names

### Data Models (warcraftlogs_client/models.py)
- Existing: SpellUsage, ConsumableUsage, PotionSpike, EncounterSummary, RaidAnalysis
- RaidAnalysis has: metadata, composition, healers, tanks, dps, consumables, encounters, warnings
- No models for buff timelines or interrupt tracking

### Database (warcraftlogs_client/database.py)
- PerformanceDB class with SQLite
- `import_raid(analysis: RaidAnalysis)` persists everything
- `get_raid_analysis(report_id)` reconstructs from DB
- Schema version tracked (currently 2)
- Tables: characters, raids, healer_performance, tank_performance, dps_performance, consumable_usage, encounters, encounter_performance, etc.

### GUI (warcraftlogs_client/gui/)
- PySide6 with dark theme (styles.py COLORS dict)
- Charts built with QtCharts (charts.py) — factory functions return QChartView
- Custom painted widgets: SpiderChartWidget, CalendarHeatmapWidget, ConsumableTimelineHeatmap, OverlayTimelineHeatmap
- RaidAnalysisWidget has 9+ tabs: Healers, Tanks, Melee DPS, Ranged DPS, Consumables, Boss vs Trash, Engineering, Timeline, Encounters, Composition
- NavigationStack with push/pop drill-down views
- Existing ConsumableTimelineHeatmap custom paints a player × minute grid
- InsightsView has tabs with charts, filters, lazy loading

### Key Patterns
- Analysis follows: API fetch → filter/compute → return dataclass list
- DB follows: import_raid writes, get_raid_analysis reads, schema migrations bump version
- GUI follows: lazy load in showEvent, QAbstractTableModel for tables, factory functions for charts, QPainter for custom visualizations
- Config-driven: JSON config files with spell ID → name mappings
- Always go through PRs, never push directly to master

## What to Build

### Feature 1: Buff/Debuff Uptime Timelines
- **Goal**: Show visual timeline bars of key raid debuffs on bosses (Sunder Armor, Improved Scorch, Curse of Elements, Judgement of Wisdom, etc.) and key buffs per fight
- **API**: Need new client method for `dataType: Debuffs, hostilityType: Enemies` or use `dataType: Buffs` table which already has bands data
- **Key insight**: For debuffs on bosses, we actually want to know uptime of specific debuffs. The WCL `table` endpoint with `dataType: Debuffs, hostilityType: Enemies` and a fight time window would give us debuff bands on bosses. Alternatively, we can query per-fight debuff events.
- **Visualization**: Horizontal timeline bars per debuff per fight. Each bar shows uptime windows colored, gaps uncolored. Fight duration as the x-axis. Similar to Duck Analyzer's interactive timeline.
- **Config**: A `debuff_config.json` or add a section to existing config with tracked debuff spell IDs

### Feature 2: Interrupt Tracking
- **Goal**: Track per-player interrupt counts per fight and per raid
- **API**: Filter cast events by interrupt spell IDs (Kick=1766, Pummel=6552, Earth Shock=8042, Counterspell=2139, Shield Bash=72)
- **Already have**: `get_cast_events_paginated()` returns all casts; filter post-fetch
- **Storage**: New DB table for interrupt data
- **Display**: Table showing player × interrupt spell grid, plus per-encounter breakdown

### Feature 3: Log-to-Log Comparison (Raid Diff)
- **Goal**: Side-by-side comparison of two raid nights showing what changed
- **We already have**: Head-to-Head panel in reference_view.py that compares guild vs reference raids. The ReferenceView's _HeadToHeadPanel is essentially this pattern already.
- **Enhancement**: Make this work for any two guild raids, not just guild-vs-reference. Add it as a feature in the Raids view or as a standalone comparison option.

## Constraints
- Must follow existing patterns (dataclass models, analysis functions, DB tables, GUI tab patterns)
- Schema version bump needed for new DB tables
- API calls should be efficient — minimize calls per player
- The project uses Python 3.10+, PySide6, SQLite
- Test coverage expected (pytest, existing tests in tests/)

Please design a detailed implementation plan with:
1. New/modified files and what changes in each
2. Data flow for each feature
3. New models, DB tables, API methods
4. GUI integration approach
5. Testing strategy
6. Suggested phasing (what to build first)

Consider: should buff timelines be per-fight or per-raid? Should interrupt tracking be folded into the existing analysis pipeline or separate? Should log-to-log comparison reuse the HeadToHead pattern?","run_in_background":false}

## Context

Inspired by [TBC Duck Analyzer](https://github.com/patitokun03-spec/TBC-Duck-Analyzer), we're adding three capabilities the project currently lacks: **interrupt tracking**, **buff/debuff uptime timelines**, and **raid-to-raid comparison**. These fill the biggest gaps identified when benchmarking against the community tooling ecosystem.

---

## Phase 1: Interrupt Tracking

**Why first**: Zero new API calls needed — interrupts are already in the cast event stream fetched for consumable analysis. Lowest risk, validates the pattern of extending `RaidAnalysis` + DB schema.

### 1.1 Config: `interrupt_config.json` (new file)
Same `{spell_id: name}` pattern as `consumes_config.json`:
```json
{
  "1766": "Kick",
  "6552": "Pummel",
  "2139": "Counterspell",
  "72": "Shield Bash",
  "19244": "Spell Lock",
  "29443": "Arcane Torrent"
}
```
Earth Shock excluded (dual-use as damage spell — would overcount).

### 1.2 Models (`models.py`)
Add `InterruptUsage` dataclass: `player_name`, `player_class`, `source_id`, `spell_id`, `spell_name`, `count`, `timestamps`.
Add `interrupts: list[InterruptUsage] = field(default_factory=list)` to `RaidAnalysis`.

### 1.3 Paths (`paths.py`)
Add `get_interrupt_config_path()`.

### 1.4 Analysis (`analysis.py`)
Add `_load_interrupt_config()` and `_analyze_interrupts()`.
Key efficiency: reuse the cast events already fetched in `_analyze_consumables()`. Refactor so cast events are fetched once per player, then passed to both consumable and interrupt logic. Or call `_analyze_interrupts` as a separate function that calls `get_cast_events_paginated` — the API cache means no duplicate HTTP calls.
Wire into `analyze_raid()` after consumables.

### 1.5 Database (`database.py`)
New table in migration:
```sql
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS interrupt_usage (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    character_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES characters(id),
    raid_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES raids(id),
    spell_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    spell_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    timestamps TEXT DEFAULT NULL,
    UNIQUE(character_id, raid_id, spell_id)
);
```
Add to `import_raid()`, `get_raid_analysis()`, and `_migrate()`.

### 1.6 GUI: "Interrupts" tab in `RaidAnalysisWidget`
Add `InterruptTableModel` to `table_models.py` — player rows, interrupt spell columns, total column. Class-colored names.
Add tab with optional fight filter combo (All Fights + per-encounter).

### 1.7 Tests
- `test_interrupts.py`: config loading, extraction from mock cast events, fight assignment
- Update `test_database.py`: schema migration v2→v3, import/load round-trip
- Update `conftest.py`: `sample_interrupt_usage` fixture, extend `build_analysis`

---

## Phase 2: Buff/Debuff Uptime Timelines

### 2.1 Config: `debuff_config.json` (new file)
```json
{
  "boss_debuffs": {
    "11597": "Sunder Armor",
    "22959": "Fire Vulnerability",
    "27228": "Curse of Elements",
    "27226": "Curse of Recklessness",
    "20186": "Judgement of Wisdom",
    "20185": "Judgement of Light",
    "33602": "Faerie Fire",
    "12579": "Winter's Chill"
  }
}
```

### 2.2 API: new `get_debuffs_table()` in `client.py`
```python
def get_debuffs_table(self, report_id, start_time, end_time):
    # table(dataType: Debuffs, hostilityType: Enemies, startTime, endTime)
```
Returns same structure as `get_buffs_table` — `{data: {auras: [{guid, name, totalUses, bands: [{startTime, endTime}]}]}}`.
One call per boss kill (~6-10 per raid). Cached by the existing response cache.

### 2.3 Models (`models.py`)
```python
@dataclass
class AuraBand:
    start_time: int
    end_time: int

@dataclass
class AuraUptime:
    spell_id: int
    spell_name: str
    fight_name: str
    fight_start: int
    fight_end: int
    uptime_percent: float = 0.0
    bands: list[AuraBand] = field(default_factory=list)
```
Add `aura_uptimes: list[AuraUptime]` to `RaidAnalysis`.

### 2.4 Analysis (`analysis.py`)
Add `_analyze_aura_uptimes(client, report_id, boss_kills)`:
- For each boss kill, call `get_debuffs_table(report_id, start, end)`
- Filter auras by `debuff_config` spell IDs
- Compute `uptime_percent = sum(band durations) / fight_duration * 100`
- Return `list[AuraUptime]`

Wire into `analyze_raid()` after `_analyze_encounters()` (which already computes `boss_kills`).

### 2.5 Database (`database.py`)
```sql
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS aura_uptime (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    raid_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES raids(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    encounter_row_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES encounters(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    spell_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    spell_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    uptime_percent REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0,
    bands_json TEXT DEFAULT NULL,
    UNIQUE(raid_id, encounter_row_id, spell_id)
);
```
Add import/load methods. `bands_json` stores serialized band data for timeline rendering.

### 2.6 GUI: `DebuffTimelineWidget` in `charts.py` + "Debuff Uptime" tab
Custom `QPainter` widget (same pattern as `ConsumableTimelineHeatmap`):
- Y-axis: one row per debuff spell
- X-axis: fight duration (seconds)
- Colored horizontal bands for uptime windows, gaps for downtime
- Color: green ≥95%, yellow 80-95%, red <80%
- Tooltip showing exact uptime % on hover

Tab in `RaidAnalysisWidget`: fight selector combo + `DebuffTimelineWidget` + summary table (spell, uptime %, applications).

### 2.7 Tests
- `test_aura_uptime.py`: uptime calculation, band parsing, config filtering, DB round-trip

---

## Phase 3: Raid-to-Raid Comparison

### 3.1 Refactor `_HeadToHeadPanel` (`reference_view.py`)
The existing `_HeadToHeadPanel` already does guild-vs-reference comparison with metric cards, class performance tables, consumable comparison, and timeline overlays. Extract the core comparison logic into a reusable `RaidComparisonPanel` class (or add a `mode` parameter) so both combos can draw from guild raids.

### 3.2 New `RaidDiffView` (`gui/raid_diff_view.py`)
Thin wrapper that:
- Instantiates `RaidComparisonPanel` in `guild_vs_guild` mode
- Both dropdowns populated from `db.get_guild_raids()` (already exists)
- Reuses all comparison display logic (metric cards, class breakdown, consumable overlay, etc.)

### 3.3 Sidebar integration (`main_window.py`)
Add "Raid Diff" sidebar entry (icon + label). Wire into `NavigationStack`.

### 3.4 Once Phase 1+2 land, extend comparison
Add interrupt totals and debuff uptime comparisons to the comparison display.

### 3.5 Tests
- `test_raid_diff.py`: verify both combos load guild raids, comparison renders with two `RaidAnalysis` objects

---

## Files Summary

**New files** (7):
- `interrupt_config.json`, `debuff_config.json`
- `warcraftlogs_client/gui/raid_diff_view.py`
- `tests/test_interrupts.py`, `tests/test_aura_uptime.py`, `tests/test_raid_diff.py`

**Modified files** (9):
- `warcraftlogs_client/models.py` — new dataclasses, extend RaidAnalysis
- `warcraftlogs_client/paths.py` — new config path helpers
- `warcraftlogs_client/client.py` — add `get_debuffs_table()`
- `warcraftlogs_client/analysis.py` — add `_analyze_interrupts()`, `_analyze_aura_uptimes()`
- `warcraftlogs_client/database.py` — new tables, migration, import/load
- `warcraftlogs_client/gui/raid_analysis_widget.py` — Interrupts + Debuff Uptime tabs
- `warcraftlogs_client/gui/table_models.py` — InterruptTableModel
- `warcraftlogs_client/gui/charts.py` — DebuffTimelineWidget
- `warcraftlogs_client/gui/main_window.py` — Raid Diff sidebar entry

---

## Verification

1. **Unit tests**: `pytest tests/test_interrupts.py tests/test_aura_uptime.py tests/test_raid_diff.py`
2. **Full test suite**: `pytest` (verify no regressions)
3. **Schema migration**: delete DB, re-run — tables created. Keep DB, re-run — migration adds new tables without data loss.
4. **Live test**: Analyze a raid report, verify Interrupts tab shows data, Debuff Uptime tab shows timeline, Raid Diff view loads two raids for comparison.
5. **Lint**: `ruff check warcraftlogs_client/`

class DebuffTimelineWidget(QWidget):
    """Horizontal timeline bars showing debuff uptime per boss fight."""

    def __init__(self, parent=None):
        super().__init__(parent)
        self._uptimes: list = []
        self._fight_start: int = 0
        self._fight_end: int = 0
        self._cells: list[tuple[QRectF, str, float]] = []
        self.setMouseTracking(True)
        self.setMinimumHeight(60)

    def set_data(self, uptimes, fight_start: int, fight_end: int):
        self._uptimes = uptimes
        self._fight_start = fight_start
        self._fight_end = fight_end
        rows = len(uptimes) if uptimes else 1
        self.setMinimumHeight(40 + rows * 36 + 30)
        self.update()

    def paintEvent(self, event):
        painter = QPainter(self)
        painter.setRenderHint(QPainter.RenderHint.Antialiasing)
        painter.fillRect(self.rect(), QColor(COLORS["bg_card"]))

        if not self._uptimes or self._fight_end <= self._fight_start:
            painter.setPen(QColor(COLORS["text_dim"]))
            painter.setFont(QFont("Segoe UI", 11))
            painter.drawText(
                self.rect(), Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignCenter, "No debuff data for this fight"
            )
            painter.end()
            return

        name_col_w = 150
        top_margin = 30
        row_h = 28
        row_gap = 8
        right_pad = 60

        duration = self._fight_end - self._fight_start
        duration_s = duration / 1000
        avail_w = self.width() - name_col_w - right_pad
        if avail_w < 100:
            avail_w = 100

        label_font = QFont("Segoe UI", 7)
        name_font = QFont("Segoe UI", 9)
        pct_font = QFont("Segoe UI", 8, QFont.Weight.Bold)

        painter.setPen(QColor(COLORS["text_dim"]))
        painter.setFont(label_font)
        interval = 30
        if duration_s > 300:
            interval = 60
        t = 0
        while t <= duration_s:
            x = name_col_w + (t / duration_s) * avail_w
            m = int(t) // 60
            s = int(t) % 60
            painter.drawText(int(x) - 10, top_margin - 6, f"{m}:{s:02d}")
            painter.setPen(QPen(QColor(COLORS["border"]), 1, Qt.PenStyle.DotLine))
            painter.drawLine(int(x), top_margin, int(x), top_margin + len(self._uptimes) * (row_h + row_gap))
            painter.setPen(QColor(COLORS["text_dim"]))
            t += interval

        self._cells = []
        for i, au in enumerate(self._uptimes):
            y = top_margin + i * (row_h + row_gap)

            painter.setPen(QColor(COLORS["text"]))
            painter.setFont(name_font)
            painter.drawText(4, int(y + row_h - 8), au.spell_name[:18])

            bg_rect = QRectF(name_col_w, y, avail_w, row_h)
            painter.setPen(Qt.PenStyle.NoPen)
            painter.setBrush(QBrush(QColor(COLORS["bg_dark"])))
            painter.drawRoundedRect(bg_rect, 3, 3)

            if au.uptime_percent >= 95:
                band_color = QColor("#2ecc71")
            elif au.uptime_percent >= 80:
                band_color = QColor("#f39c12")
            else:
                band_color = QColor("#e74c3c")

            for band in au.bands:
                bs = max(band.start_time - self._fight_start, 0)
                be = min(band.end_time - self._fight_start, duration)
                if be <= bs:
                    continue
                bx = name_col_w + (bs / duration) * avail_w
                bw = ((be - bs) / duration) * avail_w
                band_rect = QRectF(bx, y + 2, max(bw, 2), row_h - 4)
                painter.setBrush(QBrush(band_color))
                painter.drawRoundedRect(band_rect, 2, 2)

            self._cells.append((bg_rect, au.spell_name, au.uptime_percent))

            pct_x = name_col_w + avail_w + 8
            painter.setPen(band_color)
            painter.setFont(pct_font)
            painter.drawText(int(pct_x), int(y + row_h - 8), f"{au.uptime_percent:.1f}%")

        painter.end()

    def mouseMoveEvent(self, event):
        pos = event.position() if hasattr(event, "position") else event.pos()
        for rect, name, pct in self._cells:
            if rect.contains(pos):
                tip = f"{name}: {pct:.1f}% uptime"
                tip_pos = (
                    event.globalPosition().toPoint()
                    if hasattr(event, "globalPosition")
                    else event.globalPos()
                )
                QToolTip.showText(tip_pos, tip, self)
                return
        QToolTip.hideText()
        super().mouseMoveEvent(event)

Raid-to-Raid comparison view for comparing two guild raids side-by-side.
"""

import sqlite3
from collections import defaultdict

from PySide6.QtCore import Qt, Signal
from PySide6.QtGui import QFont
from PySide6.QtWidgets import (
    QComboBox,
    QFrame,
    QGridLayout,
    QHBoxLayout,
    QLabel,
    QMessageBox,
    QPushButton,
    QScrollArea,
    QVBoxLayout,
    QWidget,
)

from ..database import PerformanceDB
from .styles import COLORS, COMMON_STYLES


class _MetricCard(QFrame):
    def __init__(self, title: str, parent=None):
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.setStyleSheet(
            f"QFrame {{ background-color: {COLORS['bg_card']};"
            f" border: 1px solid {COLORS['border']};"
            f" border-radius: 6px; padding: 12px; }}"
        )
        layout = QVBoxLayout(self)
        layout.setContentsMargins(12, 8, 12, 8)
        layout.setSpacing(4)

        title_lbl = QLabel(title)
        title_lbl.setFont(QFont("Segoe UI", 9))
        title_lbl.setStyleSheet(f"color: {COLORS['text_dim']}; border: none;")
        layout.addWidget(title_lbl)

        self._raid_a_lbl = QLabel("Raid A: —")
        self._raid_a_lbl.setFont(QFont("Segoe UI", 11, QFont.Weight.Bold))
        self._raid_a_lbl.setStyleSheet(f"color: {COLORS['accent']}; border: none;")
        layout.addWidget(self._raid_a_lbl)

        self._raid_b_lbl = QLabel("Raid B: —")
        self._raid_b_lbl.setFont(QFont("Segoe UI", 11, QFont.Weight.Bold))
        self._raid_b_lbl.setStyleSheet(f"color: #69CCF0; border: none;")
        layout.addWidget(self._raid_b_lbl)

        self._delta_lbl = QLabel()
        self._delta_lbl.setFont(QFont("Segoe UI", 10))
        self._delta_lbl.setStyleSheet(f"color: {COLORS['text_dim']}; border: none;")
        layout.addWidget(self._delta_lbl)

    def set_values(self, val_a, val_b, higher_is_better=True, fmt="{:,.0f}"):
        self._raid_a_lbl.setText(f"Raid A: {fmt.format(val_a)}" if val_a is not None else "Raid A: —")
        self._raid_b_lbl.setText(f"Raid B: {fmt.format(val_b)}" if val_b is not None else "Raid B: —")
        if val_a is not None and val_b is not None and val_b != 0:
            delta_pct = (val_a - val_b) / abs(val_b) * 100
            sign = "+" if delta_pct > 0 else ""
            if higher_is_better:
                is_better = delta_pct > 0
            else:
                is_better = delta_pct < 0
            color = COLORS["success"] if is_better else COLORS["error"]
            self._delta_lbl.setText(f"{sign}{delta_pct:.1f}%")
            self._delta_lbl.setStyleSheet(f"color: {color}; border: none;")


class RaidDiffView(QWidget):
    status_message = Signal(str)

    def __init__(self, parent=None):
        super().__init__(parent)
        self._shown = False
        self._build_ui()

    def _build_ui(self):
        self.setStyleSheet(COMMON_STYLES)
        layout = QVBoxLayout(self)
        layout.setContentsMargins(24, 20, 24, 20)
        layout.setSpacing(12)

        title = QLabel("Raid-to-Raid Comparison")
        title.setFont(QFont("Segoe UI", 16, QFont.Weight.Bold))
        title.setStyleSheet(f"color: {COLORS['text_header']};")
        layout.addWidget(title)

        desc = QLabel("Compare two guild raids side-by-side to track progression between raid nights.")
        desc.setWordWrap(True)
        desc.setStyleSheet(f"color: {COLORS['text_dim']}; font-size: 12px;")
        layout.addWidget(desc)

        selector_row = QHBoxLayout()
        selector_row.setSpacing(10)

        selector_row.addWidget(QLabel("Raid A:"))
        self._combo_a = QComboBox()
        self._combo_a.setMinimumWidth(300)
        selector_row.addWidget(self._combo_a, 1)

        vs_label = QLabel("vs")
        vs_label.setFont(QFont("Segoe UI", 12, QFont.Weight.Bold))
        vs_label.setStyleSheet(f"color: {COLORS['accent']};")
        selector_row.addWidget(vs_label)

        selector_row.addWidget(QLabel("Raid B:"))
        self._combo_b = QComboBox()
        self._combo_b.setMinimumWidth(300)
        selector_row.addWidget(self._combo_b, 1)

        self._compare_btn = QPushButton("Compare")
        self._compare_btn.setFixedHeight(36)
        self._compare_btn.clicked.connect(self._run_comparison)
        selector_row.addWidget(self._compare_btn)

        layout.addLayout(selector_row)

        self._scroll = QScrollArea()
        self._scroll.setWidgetResizable(True)
        self._scroll.setStyleSheet(
            f"QScrollArea {{ border: none; background-color: {COLORS['bg_dark']}; }}"
        )
        self._content = QWidget()
        self._content.setStyleSheet(f"background-color: {COLORS['bg_dark']};")
        self._content_layout = QVBoxLayout(self._content)
        self._content_layout.setContentsMargins(8, 8, 8, 8)
        self._content_layout.setSpacing(16)

        placeholder = QLabel("Select two raids and click Compare.")
        placeholder.setStyleSheet(f"color: {COLORS['text_dim']}; font-size: 13px;")
        placeholder.setAlignment(Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignCenter)
        self._content_layout.addWidget(placeholder)
        self._content_layout.addStretch()

        self._scroll.setWidget(self._content)
        layout.addWidget(self._scroll, 1)

    def showEvent(self, event):
        super().showEvent(event)
        if not self._shown:
            self._shown = True
            self._populate_combos()
        else:
            self._populate_combos()

    def _populate_combos(self):
        try:
            with PerformanceDB() as db:
                raids = db.get_guild_raids_for_comparison()
        except (sqlite3.Error, OSError):
            raids = []

        for combo in (self._combo_a, self._combo_b):
            combo.blockSignals(True)
            current = combo.currentData(Qt.ItemDataRole.UserRole)
            combo.clear()
            for r in raids:
                parts = [r.get("raid_date", "")[:10], r.get("title", "")]
                if r.get("zone"):
                    parts.append(r["zone"])
                if r.get("raid_size"):
                    parts.append(f"{r['raid_size']}-man")
                display = " — ".join(parts[:2])
                if len(parts) > 2:
                    display += f" ({', '.join(parts[2:])})"
                combo.addItem(display, r["report_id"])
            if current:
                idx = combo.findData(current, Qt.ItemDataRole.UserRole)
                if idx >= 0:
                    combo.setCurrentIndex(idx)
            combo.blockSignals(False)

        if len(raids) >= 2 and self._combo_b.count() >= 2:
            self._combo_b.setCurrentIndex(1)

        self._compare_btn.setEnabled(self._combo_a.count() >= 2)

    def _run_comparison(self):
        id_a = self._combo_a.currentData(Qt.ItemDataRole.UserRole)
        id_b = self._combo_b.currentData(Qt.ItemDataRole.UserRole)
        if not id_a or not id_b:
            return
        if id_a == id_b:
            QMessageBox.warning(self, "Same Raid", "Please select two different raids to compare.")
            return

        try:
            with PerformanceDB() as db:
                analysis_a = db.get_raid_analysis(id_a)
                analysis_b = db.get_raid_analysis(id_b)
                stats_a = db.get_raid_aggregate_stats(id_a)
                stats_b = db.get_raid_aggregate_stats(id_b)
        except (sqlite3.Error, OSError) as e:

            return

    def _clear_content(self):
        old = self._scroll.takeWidget()
        if old:
            old.deleteLater()
        self._content = QWidget()
        self._content.setStyleSheet(f"background-color: {COLORS['bg_dark']};")
        self._content_layout = QVBoxLayout(self._content)
        self._content_layout.setContentsMargins(8, 8, 8, 8)
        self._content_layout.setSpacing(16)

    def _add_section_header(self, layout, text):
        lbl = QLabel(text)
        lbl.setFont(QFont("Segoe UI", 13, QFont.Weight.Bold))
        lbl.setStyleSheet(
            f"color: {COLORS['text_header']};"
            f" border-bottom: 2px solid {COLORS['accent']};"
            f" padding-bottom: 6px;"
        )
        if isinstance(layout, QVBoxLayout):
            layout.addWidget(lbl)
        else:
            layout.addWidget(lbl)

    def _display_comparison(self, raid_a, raid_b, stats_a, stats_b):
        self._clear_content()
        layout = self._content_layout

        # ── Raid Overview ──
        self._add_section_header(layout, "Raid Overview")
        cards = QGridLayout()
        cards.setSpacing(12)

        dur_card = _MetricCard("Duration")
        g_dur = stats_a.get("duration_ms")
        r_dur = stats_b.get("duration_ms")
        if g_dur is not None:
            dur_card._raid_a_lbl.setText(f"Raid A: {int(g_dur / 1000) // 60}:{int(g_dur / 1000) % 60:02d}")
        if r_dur is not None:
            dur_card._raid_b_lbl.setText(f"Raid B: {int(r_dur / 1000) // 60}:{int(r_dur / 1000) % 60:02d}")
        if g_dur and r_dur and r_dur != 0:
            delta_pct = (g_dur - r_dur) / abs(r_dur) * 100
            sign = "+" if delta_pct > 0 else ""
            color = COLORS["success"] if delta_pct < 0 else COLORS["error"]
            dur_card._delta_lbl.setText(f"{sign}{delta_pct:.1f}%")
            dur_card._delta_lbl.setStyleSheet(f"color: {color}; border: none;")

        dmg_card = _MetricCard("Total Damage")
        dmg_card.set_values(stats_a.get("total_damage"), stats_b.get("total_damage"))

        heal_card = _MetricCard("Total Healing")
        heal_card.set_values(stats_a.get("total_healing"), stats_b.get("total_healing"))

        size_card = _MetricCard("Raid Size")
        size_card.set_values(stats_a.get("raid_size"), stats_b.get("raid_size"), fmt="{:.0f}")

        taken_card = _MetricCard("Damage Taken")
        taken_card.set_values(
            stats_a.get("total_damage_taken"),
            stats_b.get("total_damage_taken"),
            higher_is_better=False,
        )

        dps_a = len(raid_a.dps) or 1
        dps_b = len(raid_b.dps) or 1
        avg_a = stats_a.get("total_damage", 0) / dps_a if stats_a.get("total_damage") else None
        avg_b = stats_b.get("total_damage", 0) / dps_b if stats_b.get("total_damage") else None
        avg_card = _MetricCard("Avg DPS per Player")
        avg_card.set_values(avg_a, avg_b)

        cards.addWidget(dur_card, 0, 0)
        cards.addWidget(dmg_card, 0, 1)
        cards.addWidget(heal_card, 0, 2)
        cards.addWidget(size_card, 1, 0)
        cards.addWidget(taken_card, 1, 1)
        cards.addWidget(avg_card, 1, 2)
        layout.addLayout(cards)

        # ── Composition ──
        self._add_section_header(layout, "Raid Composition")
        comp_grid = QGridLayout()
        comp_grid.setSpacing(6)

        a_classes = defaultdict(int)
        for p in raid_a.composition.all_players:
            a_classes[p.player_class] += 1
        b_classes = defaultdict(int)
        for p in raid_b.composition.all_players:
            b_classes[p.player_class] += 1
        all_classes = sorted(set(a_classes.keys()) | set(b_classes.keys()))

        for col, header in enumerate(["Class", "Raid A", "Raid B", "Delta"]):
            lbl = QLabel(header)
            lbl.setFont(QFont("Segoe UI", 10, QFont.Weight.Bold))
            lbl.setStyleSheet(f"color: {COLORS['text_dim']};")
            comp_grid.addWidget(lbl, 0, col)

        for i, cls in enumerate(all_classes, start=1):
            ac = a_classes.get(cls, 0)
            bc = b_classes.get(cls, 0)
            delta = ac - bc

            comp_grid.addWidget(self._styled_label(cls, COLORS["text"]), i, 0)
            comp_grid.addWidget(self._styled_label(str(ac), COLORS["accent"]), i, 1)
            comp_grid.addWidget(self._styled_label(str(bc), "#69CCF0"), i, 2)

            sign = "+" if delta > 0 else ""
            d_color = COLORS["success"] if delta > 0 else (COLORS["error"] if delta < 0 else COLORS["text_dim"])
            comp_grid.addWidget(
                self._styled_label(f"{sign}{delta}" if delta != 0 else "=", d_color), i, 3
            )

        layout.addLayout(comp_grid)

        # ── Consumable comparison ──
        self._add_section_header(layout, "Consumable Usage")
        a_cons = self._compute_consumable_summary(raid_a)
        b_cons = self._compute_consumable_summary(raid_b)
        all_consumables = sorted(set(a_cons.keys()) | set(b_cons.keys()))

        if all_consumables:
            cons_grid = QGridLayout()
            cons_grid.setSpacing(6)
            for col, header in enumerate(["Consumable", "A Uses", "A Users", "B Uses", "B Users", "Delta"]):
                lbl = QLabel(header)
                lbl.setFont(QFont("Segoe UI", 9, QFont.Weight.Bold))
                lbl.setStyleSheet(f"color: {COLORS['text_dim']};")
                cons_grid.addWidget(lbl, 0, col)

            for i, name in enumerate(all_consumables, start=1):
                ac = a_cons.get(name, {})
                bc = b_cons.get(name, {})
                a_uses = ac.get("total_uses", 0)
                b_uses = bc.get("total_uses", 0)
                delta = a_uses - b_uses

                cons_grid.addWidget(self._styled_label(name, COLORS["text"]), i, 0)
                cons_grid.addWidget(self._styled_label(str(a_uses), COLORS["accent"]), i, 1)
                cons_grid.addWidget(self._styled_label(str(ac.get("unique_users", 0)), COLORS["text_dim"]), i, 2)
                cons_grid.addWidget(self._styled_label(str(b_uses), "#69CCF0"), i, 3)
                cons_grid.addWidget(self._styled_label(str(bc.get("unique_users", 0)), COLORS["text_dim"]), i, 4)

                sign = "+" if delta > 0 else ""
                d_color = COLORS["success"] if delta > 0 else (COLORS["error"] if delta < 0 else COLORS["text_dim"])
                cons_grid.addWidget(
                    self._styled_label(f"{sign}{delta}" if delta != 0 else "=", d_color), i, 5
                )
            layout.addLayout(cons_grid)
        else:
            layout.addWidget(self._styled_label("No consumable data available.", COLORS["text_dim"]))

        # ── Interrupt comparison ──
        a_ints = self._compute_interrupt_summary(raid_a)
        b_ints = self._compute_interrupt_summary(raid_b)
        if a_ints or b_ints:
            self._add_section_header(layout, "Interrupt Usage")
            int_grid = QGridLayout()
            int_grid.setSpacing(6)
            all_spells = sorted(set(a_ints.keys()) | set(b_ints.keys()))

            for col, header in enumerate(["Interrupt", "Raid A", "Raid B", "Delta"]):
                lbl = QLabel(header)
                lbl.setFont(QFont("Segoe UI", 9, QFont.Weight.Bold))
                lbl.setStyleSheet(f"color: {COLORS['text_dim']};")
                int_grid.addWidget(lbl, 0, col)

            for i, spell in enumerate(all_spells, start=1):
                a_count = a_ints.get(spell, 0)
                b_count = b_ints.get(spell, 0)
                delta = a_count - b_count

                int_grid.addWidget(self._styled_label(spell, COLORS["text"]), i, 0)
                int_grid.addWidget(self._styled_label(str(a_count), COLORS["accent"]), i, 1)
                int_grid.addWidget(self._styled_label(str(b_count), "#69CCF0"), i, 2)

                sign = "+" if delta > 0 else ""
                d_color = COLORS["success"] if delta > 0 else (COLORS["error"] if delta < 0 else COLORS["text_dim"])
                int_grid.addWidget(
                    self._styled_label(f"{sign}{delta}" if delta != 0 else "=", d_color), i, 3
                )
            layout.addLayout(int_grid)

        # ── Encounter comparison ──
        a_encs = {e.name: e for e in raid_a.encounters}
        b_encs = {e.name: e for e in raid_b.encounters}
        shared_bosses = sorted(set(a_encs.keys()) & set(b_encs.keys()))

        if shared_bosses:
            self._add_section_header(layout, "Shared Boss Encounters")
            enc_grid = QGridLayout()
            enc_grid.setSpacing(6)
            for col, header in enumerate(["Boss", "A Duration", "B Duration", "A Damage", "B Damage", "Delta"]):
                lbl = QLabel(header)
                lbl.setFont(QFont("Segoe UI", 9, QFont.Weight.Bold))
                lbl.setStyleSheet(f"color: {COLORS['text_dim']};")
                enc_grid.addWidget(lbl, 0, col)

            for i, boss in enumerate(shared_bosses, start=1):
                ea = a_encs[boss]
                eb = b_encs[boss]
                dur_a_s = ea.duration_ms // 1000
                dur_b_s = eb.duration_ms // 1000
                dmg_a = sum(p.total_damage for p in ea.players)
                dmg_b = sum(p.total_damage for p in eb.players)

                enc_grid.addWidget(self._styled_label(boss, COLORS["text"]), i, 0)
                enc_grid.addWidget(
                    self._styled_label(f"{dur_a_s // 60}:{dur_a_s % 60:02d}", COLORS["accent"]), i, 1
                )
                enc_grid.addWidget(
                    self._styled_label(f"{dur_b_s // 60}:{dur_b_s % 60:02d}", "#69CCF0"), i, 2
                )
                enc_grid.addWidget(self._styled_label(f"{dmg_a:,}", COLORS["accent"]), i, 3)
                enc_grid.addWidget(self._styled_label(f"{dmg_b:,}", "#69CCF0"), i, 4)

                if dmg_b > 0:
                    delta_pct = (dmg_a - dmg_b) / dmg_b * 100
                    sign = "+" if delta_pct > 0 else ""
                    color = COLORS["success"] if delta_pct > 0 else COLORS["error"]
                    enc_grid.addWidget(self._styled_label(f"{sign}{delta_pct:.1f}%", color), i, 5)
                else:
                    enc_grid.addWidget(self._styled_label("—", COLORS["text_dim"]), i, 5)

            layout.addLayout(enc_grid)

        layout.addStretch()
        self._scroll.setWidget(self._content)

    def _styled_label(self, text: str, color: str) -> QLabel:
        lbl = QLabel(text)
        lbl.setStyleSheet(f"color: {color};")
        return lbl

    @staticmethod
    def _compute_consumable_summary(analysis):
        summary = {}
        for c in analysis.consumables:
            if c.consumable_name not in summary:
                summary[c.consumable_name] = {"total_uses": 0, "unique_users": 0, "users": set()}
            summary[c.consumable_name]["total_uses"] += c.count
            summary[c.consumable_name]["users"].add(c.player_name)
        for v in summary.values():
            v["unique_users"] = len(v["users"])
            del v["users"]
        return summary

    @staticmethod
    def _compute_interrupt_summary(analysis):
        summary = defaultdict(int)
        for iu in analysis.interrupts:
            summary[iu.spell_name] += iu.count
        return dict(summary)

## Context

The user wants to track shaman totem uptime per boss fight. WCL API does NOT expose totem buffs via the `Buffs` table endpoint (totem auras don't appear in `dataType: Buffs`). Instead, totem **placement casts** are available via cast events. We compute uptime from cast timestamps + totem duration (120s for most totems, 12s for Mana Tide).

Real totem spell IDs confirmed from the user's API data:
```
25587  Windfury Totem          25570  Mana Spring Totem
25359  Grace of Air Totem      25567  Healing Stream Totem
25528  Strength of Earth Totem 30706  Totem of Wrath
 3738  Wrath of Air Totem      25509  Stoneskin Totem
25533  Searing Totem            8143  Tremor Totem
25552  Magma Totem              8177  Grounding Totem
16190  Mana Tide Totem          2894  Fire Elemental Totem
```

---

## Implementation

### 1. Config: `totem_config.json` (new file)

```json
{
  "totems": {
    "25587": {"name": "Windfury Totem", "duration": 120},
    "25359": {"name": "Grace of Air Totem", "duration": 120},
    "25528": {"name": "Strength of Earth Totem", "duration": 120},
    "3738":  {"name": "Wrath of Air Totem", "duration": 120},
    "25570": {"name": "Mana Spring Totem", "duration": 120},
    "25567": {"name": "Healing Stream Totem", "duration": 120},
    "30706": {"name": "Totem of Wrath", "duration": 120},
    "25509": {"name": "Stoneskin Totem", "duration": 120},
    "25533": {"name": "Searing Totem", "duration": 60},
    "25552": {"name": "Magma Totem", "duration": 20},
    "8143":  {"name": "Tremor Totem", "duration": 120},
    "8177":  {"name": "Grounding Totem", "duration": 45},
    "16190": {"name": "Mana Tide Totem", "duration": 12}
  }
}
```

### 2. Paths: `paths.py`
Add `get_totem_config_path()` — same pattern as `get_debuff_config_path()` (line 84).

### 3. Models: `models.py`
Add `totem_uptimes: list[AuraUptime] = field(default_factory=list)` to `RaidAnalysis` (line ~240). Reuse existing `AuraUptime` and `AuraBand` dataclasses — they fit perfectly.

### 4. Analysis: `analysis.py`
Add `_load_totem_config()` — loads `totem_config.json`, returns `dict[int, dict]` mapping spell_id → `{name, duration}`.

Add `_analyze_totem_uptimes(client, report_id, composition, encounters)`:
- For each shaman in composition (all roles), for each encounter:
  - Get cast events via `get_cast_events_paginated(report_id, source_id)` (already cached from consumable/interrupt analysis)
  - Filter casts by totem spell IDs and fight time window
  - For each totem type found: build bands from cast timestamps (each cast starts a window of `duration` seconds, clamped to fight end)
  - Merge overlapping bands from multiple shamans casting the same totem type
  - Compute `uptime_percent = sum(band_durations) / fight_duration * 100`
  - Return `list[AuraUptime]` with bands for timeline rendering

Wire into `analyze_raid()` after `_analyze_interrupts()`.

### 5. Database: `database.py`
New table via migration:
```sql
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS totem_uptime (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    raid_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES raids(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    encounter_row_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES encounters(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    spell_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    spell_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    uptime_percent REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0,
    bands_json TEXT DEFAULT NULL,
    UNIQUE(raid_id, encounter_row_id, spell_id)
);
```

Add `_import_totem_uptimes()` and `_load_totem_uptimes_for_raid()` — mirror the aura_uptime methods.
Add `DELETE FROM totem_uptime` to `delete_raid()`.
Wire import in `import_raid()` and load in `get_raid_analysis()`.

### 6. GUI: `raid_analysis_widget.py`
Add "Totem Uptime" tab — identical pattern to the Debuff Uptime tab (lines 206-227):
- Fight selector combo (`_tu_combo`) + `DebuffTimelineWidget` (`_tu_timeline`) in a scroll area
- `_on_totem_fight_changed()` handler filters `totem_uptimes` for the selected fight
- Hide tab when no data

Reuse `DebuffTimelineWidget` from `charts.py` directly — it already renders `AuraUptime` objects with colored timeline bars.

### 7. Tests
- `tests/test_totem_uptime.py`: config loading, uptime computation from cast timestamps, band merging, DB round-trip
- Update `tests/conftest.py` if needed

2. `pytest` — all tests pass including new ones

class TestMergeBands:
    def test_non_overlapping(self):
        bands = [
            AuraBand(start_time=100, end_time=200),
            AuraBand(start_time=300, end_time=400),
        ]
        merged = _merge_bands(bands)
        assert len(merged) == 2

    def test_overlapping(self):
        bands = [
            AuraBand(start_time=100, end_time=300),
            AuraBand(start_time=200, end_time=400),
        ]
        merged = _merge_bands(bands)
        assert len(merged) == 1
        assert merged[0].start_time == 100
        assert merged[0].end_time == 400

    def test_adjacent(self):
        bands = [
            AuraBand(start_time=100, end_time=200),
            AuraBand(start_time=200, end_time=300),
        ]
        merged = _merge_bands(bands)
        assert len(merged) == 1
        assert merged[0].end_time == 300

    def test_contained(self):
        bands = [
            AuraBand(start_time=100, end_time=500),
            AuraBand(start_time=200, end_time=300),
        ]
        merged = _merge_bands(bands)
        assert len(merged) == 1
        assert merged[0].end_time == 500

    def test_empty(self):
        assert _merge_bands([]) == []

    def test_unsorted_input(self):
        bands = [
            AuraBand(start_time=300, end_time=400),
            AuraBand(start_time=100, end_time=200),
        ]
        merged = _merge_bands(bands)
        assert len(merged) == 2
        assert merged[0].start_time == 100

Agent {"description":"Design My Character dashboard plan","subagent_type":"Plan","run_in_background":false,"prompt":"Design an implementation plan for enhancing the "My Character" view in a PySide6 WoW raid analysis app. The user wants their main character's average performance across all raids, with comparison to others in the same role.

## Current State

### Existing CharacterView (`warcraftlogs_client/gui/character_view.py`, ~1093 lines)
Already at nav index 4 ("My Character") in the sidebar. It's a scrollable page with:
- Character settings (name, server, region) — collapsible
- WCL Profile link
- Summary card (Name, Class, Level, Faction, Guild, Best/Median Avg from WCL API)
- Raid History Stats card (Raids Tracked, Active Period, Avg Active Time, Avg Healing, Avg Damage, Avg Mitigation, Consumables Used — from local DB `get_character_history()`)
- Encounter Rankings table (Boss, Best %, Median %, Kills — from WCL API)
- Recent Reports list
- Gear table
- Performance Trends: tabs for Healing/Tank/DPS/Consumables with chart combos + trend tables, filtered by raid size
- Local Performance: Personal Bests, Radar (7-axis spider), Calendar heatmap

### Existing DB Methods Available (in `warcraftlogs_client/database.py`)
Character-specific:
- `get_character_history(name)` → CharacterHistory with avg_healing, avg_damage, avg_mitigation, total_consumables, avg_active_time
- `get_character_consistency(name)` → consistency scores (100 - CV%)
- `get_character_personal_bests(name)` → best/worst raids
- `get_character_consumable_compliance(name)` → % raids with consumes, avg per raid
- `get_character_spider_data(name)` → percentile ranks (0-100) across 7 dimensions vs ALL characters
- `get_character_encounter_history(name, encounter_id)` → per-boss history over time
- Trend queries: `get_healer_trend()`, `get_tank_trend()`, `get_dps_trend()` — per-raid stats over time

Role-group averages (used by insights/comparison views):
- `get_healer_insights(min_raids)` → per-healer: avg_healing, avg_overheal%, dispels
- `get_tank_mitigation_stats(min_raids)` → per-tank: avg_mitigation%, avg_damage_taken
- `get_dps_consistency(min_raids)` → per-DPS: avg_damage, consistency
- `get_dps_per_minute(min_raids)` → per-DPS: damage per minute
- `get_comparison_aggregates(source, zone, raid_size)` → guild-wide role averages: avg_healing, avg_damage, avg_mitigation, etc.
- `get_encounter_player_breakdown(encounter_id)` → per-player averages for a boss (AVG damage, AVG healing, grouped by role)
- `compare_characters(names, role)` → avg performance for multiple characters by role

### Key Things That DON'T Exist Yet
1. No "your performance vs role average" side-by-side comparison
2. Spider chart compares against ALL characters, not role peers
3. No per-boss "you vs role average" breakdown
4. No trend charts with role average overlay line
5. No "rank within role" (e.g., "3rd out of 5 healers")

### Architecture Patterns
- Views added to main_window.py via `addWidget()` to a `NavigationStack` (QStackedWidget)
- Charts built via factory functions in `charts.py` using QtCharts
- Tables use `QAbstractTableModel` subclasses or the generic `HistoryTableModel(list[dict], columns)`
- Collapsible sections via `_CollapsibleSection` in character_view.py
- Background workers for DB/API queries
- DB methods accept filter params: `raid_day`, `raid_size`, `last_n`, `zone`

### DB Schema for Reference
- `healer_performance`: character_id, raid_id, total_healing, total_overhealing, overheal_percent, fear_ward_casts, total_dispels, active_time_percent
- `tank_performance`: character_id, raid_id, total_damage_taken, total_mitigated, mitigation_percent, active_time_percent
- `dps_performance`: character_id, raid_id, role (melee/ranged), total_damage, active_time_percent
- `encounter_performance`: encounter_row_id, character_id, role, total_damage, total_healing, total_damage_taken, active_time_percent
- `encounters`: raid_id, encounter_id, name, start_time, end_time, duration_ms

## Requirements

The user wants:
1. Choose their main character (already works via settings)
2. See average performance across all raids (partially exists in Raid History Stats card)
3. **See comparison to others in the same role** — this is the main new feature

## Design Constraints
- Enhance the existing CharacterView rather than creating a new view
- Reuse existing DB methods where possible, add new ones as needed
- Follow existing patterns (collapsible sections, chart factories, HistoryTableModel)
- The character's role should be auto-detected (whichever role table has most rows)
- Support the existing raid_size filter already in the trends section

## What to Design

Please design the specific new sections/widgets to add to CharacterView:

1. **Role Comparison Summary** — A card/section showing the character's key metrics side-by-side with the role average, with delta percentages (e.g., "Your Avg Healing: 500k | Role Avg: 420k | +19%")

2. **Per-Boss Performance Table** — For each boss the character has killed, show their avg performance vs the role average for that boss, with rank (e.g., "2nd of 4 healers")

3. **Trend with Role Average** — Enhance or add trend charts that show the character's performance line overlaid with a dotted "role average" line

Specify:
- Exact new DB methods needed (with SQL sketch)
- Which existing DB methods to reuse
- Where in CharacterView to add each section (after which existing section)
- New widgets or table models needed
- Chart modifications needed
- File-by-file changes"}

Write {"file_path":"C:\Users\leigh\.claude\plans\bubbly-bouncing-starfish.md","content":"# My Character — Role Comparison Dashboard

## Context

The user wants their "My Character" view enhanced so they can see their average performance across all raids **compared to others in the same role**. The existing `CharacterView` already shows personal stats, trends, and a radar chart, but has no role-peer comparison. This plan adds three new features: a Role Comparison summary card, a Per-Boss Comparison table, and role-average overlay lines on existing trend charts.

---

## 1. Role Auto-Detection

**New method in `database.py`:** `get_character_primary_role(name) → str | None`

Counts rows in `healer_performance`, `tank_performance`, `dps_performance` for the character (guild raids only). Returns whichever role has the most entries: `"healer"`, `"tank"`, `"melee"`, or `"ranged"`. Returns `None` if no data.

---

## 2. Role Comparison Summary Card

**Placement:** New `_CollapsibleSection("Role Comparison")` inserted after `self._db_stats_group` (line 355) and before the Encounter Rankings section.

**Layout:** Horizontal row of metric tiles. Each tile shows: Your Value, Role Avg, Delta %. Green delta = better, red = worse.

**Metrics by role:**
- **Healer:** Avg Healing, Avg Overheal %, Avg Dispels/Raid, Rank
- **Tank:** Avg Mitigation %, Avg Damage Taken, Avg Active Time, Rank  
- **DPS:** Avg Damage, Avg Active Time, Rank

**Data source:** Reuse existing `get_healer_insights(min_raids=1)`, `get_tank_mitigation_stats(min_raids=1)`, `get_dps_consistency(min_raids=1)`. These return per-player breakdowns — compute role average and rank in Python.

No new DB methods needed for this section.

---

## 3. Per-Boss Comparison Table

**Placement:** New "Boss Comparison" tab in the existing `self._local_tabs` QTabWidget (after Calendar).

**New method in `database.py`:** `get_character_boss_comparison(name) → list[dict]`

For each boss the character has encounter_performance data:
- Query the character's avg damage/healing/damage_taken for that boss
- Query all role peers' averages for the same boss
- Compute role average, delta, and rank

Returns: `[{boss_name, kills, role, my_value, role_avg, delta_pct, rank, peer_count}, ...]`

The "primary metric" depends on role: healing for healers, damage for DPS, damage_taken for tanks.

**Table columns:** Boss, Kills, Your Avg, Role Avg, Delta, Rank (e.g., "2nd of 5")

Uses a custom `_BossComparisonTableModel` inner class in `character_view.py` (same pattern as `_RankingsTableModel`) with color-coded delta column.

---

## 4. Trend Charts with Role Average Overlay

**New methods in `database.py`:** Three per-raid role-average trend methods:
- `get_healer_role_avg_trend() → list[dict]` — per-raid AVG(total_healing), AVG(overheal_percent), AVG(active_time_percent) across all healers
- `get_tank_role_avg_trend() → list[dict]` — per-raid AVG(mitigation_percent), AVG(total_damage_taken), AVG(active_time_percent) across all tanks  
- `get_dps_role_avg_trend() → list[dict]` — per-raid AVG(total_damage), AVG(active_time_percent) across all DPS

These follow the same pattern as `get_healer_overheal_trend()` (line 1251) — GROUP BY raid_id, ORDER BY raid_date.

**New helper in `charts.py`:** `_add_overlay_series(chart, points, name, x_axis, y_axis)` — adds a dashed white line labeled "Role Avg" to an existing chart.

**Modified chart functions:** Add optional `role_avg: list[dict] | None = None` parameter to:
- `build_healer_chart()` — overlay avg_healing
- `build_healer_overheal_chart()` — overlay avg_overheal
- `build_tank_chart()` — overlay avg_damage_taken
- `build_tank_mitigation_chart()` — overlay avg_mitigation
- `build_dps_chart()` — overlay avg_damage
- `build_active_time_chart()` — overlay avg_active_time

When `role_avg` is provided, parse the appropriate key from each row, add a dashed line, and include those points in `_fit_axes` so the Y-axis accommodates both series. Backward-compatible since parameter defaults to None.

**Changes in `character_view.py`:**
- In `_load_trends()`: also load the role avg trend data (based on detected role) and store as `self._all_role_avg_trend`
- In `_apply_raid_size_filter()`: filter role avg trend same way as personal trend
- In `_rebuild_healer_chart()`, `_rebuild_tank_chart()`, `_rebuild_dps_chart()`: pass `role_avg=` to chart builders

---

## File Changes

### `warcraftlogs_client/database.py` — 5 new methods
1. `get_character_primary_role(name)` — role detection (~25 lines)
2. `get_character_boss_comparison(name)` — per-boss vs role peers (~60 lines)
3. `get_healer_role_avg_trend()` — per-raid healer averages (~15 lines)
4. `get_tank_role_avg_trend()` — per-raid tank averages (~15 lines)
5. `get_dps_role_avg_trend()` — per-raid DPS averages (~15 lines)

### `warcraftlogs_client/gui/charts.py` — 1 new helper, 6 modified functions
1. Add `_add_overlay_series()` helper (~15 lines)
2. Add `role_avg` param to `build_healer_chart`, `build_healer_overheal_chart`, `build_tank_chart`, `build_tank_mitigation_chart`, `build_dps_chart`, `build_active_time_chart`

### `warcraftlogs_client/gui/character_view.py` — new sections + modified loading
1. Add `_BossComparisonTableModel` inner class (~60 lines)
2. Add Role Comparison section in `_build_ui()` (after db_stats_group)
3. Add Boss Comparison tab in `_build_ui()` (in local_tabs)
4. Add `_compute_role_comparison()` method — aggregates peer data
5. Add `_populate_role_comparison()` method — fills tile widgets
6. Modify `_load_local_performance()` — add role detection + boss comparison + role comparison
7. Modify `_load_trends()` — add role avg trend loading
8. Modify `_apply_raid_size_filter()` — filter role avg trend
9. Modify `_rebuild_healer_chart()`, `_rebuild_tank_chart()`, `_rebuild_dps_chart()` — pass role_avg

### Tests — new test file
- `tests/test_my_character.py` — role detection, boss comparison, role avg trend DB methods

---

## Verification
1. `ruff check` on all changed files
2. `pytest tests/test_my_character.py` — all new tests pass
3. Manual: open app → My Character → verify Role Comparison card shows with correct deltas
4. Manual: check Boss Comparison tab shows per-boss rank
5. Manual: check trend charts show dashed "Role Avg" overlay line

    def get_character_primary_role(self, character_name: str) -> str | None:
        """Detect primary role by counting performance rows per table."""
        conn = self._get_conn()
        char = conn.execute(
            "SELECT id FROM characters WHERE name = ? COLLATE NOCASE",
            (character_name,),
        ).fetchone()
        if not char:
            return None
        cid = char["id"]

        healer_count = conn.execute(
            "SELECT COUNT(*) as cnt FROM healer_performance hp "
            "JOIN raids r ON r.id = hp.raid_id "
            "WHERE hp.character_id = ? AND r.source = 'guild'",
            (cid,),
        ).fetchone()["cnt"]

        tank_count = conn.execute(
            "SELECT COUNT(*) as cnt FROM tank_performance tp "
            "JOIN raids r ON r.id = tp.raid_id "
            "WHERE tp.character_id = ? AND r.source = 'guild'",
            (cid,),
        ).fetchone()["cnt"]

        dps_row = conn.execute(
            "SELECT COUNT(*) as cnt, dp.role FROM dps_performance dp "
            "JOIN raids r ON r.id = dp.raid_id "
            "WHERE dp.character_id = ? AND r.source = 'guild' "
            "GROUP BY dp.role ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 1",
            (cid,),
        ).fetchone()
        dps_count = dps_row["cnt"] if dps_row else 0
        dps_role = dps_row["role"] if dps_row else "melee"

        candidates = [
            (healer_count, "healer"),
            (tank_count, "tank"),
            (dps_count, dps_role),
        ]
        best = max(candidates, key=lambda x: x[0])
        return best[1] if best[0] > 0 else None

    def get_character_boss_comparison(self, character_name: str) -> list[dict]:
        """Per-boss performance comparison against role peers."""
        conn = self._get_conn()
        char = conn.execute(
            "SELECT id FROM characters WHERE name = ? COLLATE NOCASE",
            (character_name,),
        ).fetchone()
        if not char:
            return []
        cid = char["id"]

        boss_rows = conn.execute(
            """SELECT DISTINCT e.encounter_id, e.name
               FROM encounter_performance ep
               JOIN encounters e ON e.id = ep.encounter_row_id
               JOIN raids r ON r.id = e.raid_id
               WHERE ep.character_id = ? AND r.source = 'guild'
               ORDER BY e.name""",
            (cid,),
        ).fetchall()

        results = []
        for boss in boss_rows:
            enc_id = boss["encounter_id"]

            my_row = conn.execute(
                """SELECT ep.role,
                          COUNT(*) as kills,
                          CAST(AVG(ep.total_damage) AS INTEGER) as avg_damage,
                          CAST(AVG(ep.total_healing) AS INTEGER) as avg_healing,
                          CAST(AVG(ep.total_damage_taken) AS INTEGER) as avg_damage_taken,
                          AVG(ep.active_time_percent) as avg_active_time
                   FROM encounter_performance ep
                   JOIN encounters e ON e.id = ep.encounter_row_id
                   JOIN raids r ON r.id = e.raid_id
                   WHERE ep.character_id = ? AND e.encounter_id = ? AND r.source = 'guild'
                   GROUP BY ep.role
                   ORDER BY kills DESC LIMIT 1""",
                (cid, enc_id),
            ).fetchone()
            if not my_row:
                continue

            my_role = my_row["role"]

            peers = conn.execute(
                """SELECT c.name,
                          CAST(AVG(ep.total_damage) AS INTEGER) as avg_damage,
                          CAST(AVG(ep.total_healing) AS INTEGER) as avg_healing,
                          CAST(AVG(ep.total_damage_taken) AS INTEGER) as avg_damage_taken
                   FROM encounter_performance ep
                   JOIN encounters e ON e.id = ep.encounter_row_id
                   JOIN raids r ON r.id = e.raid_id
                   JOIN characters c ON c.id = ep.character_id
                   WHERE e.encounter_id = ? AND ep.role = ? AND r.source = 'guild'
                   GROUP BY c.id""",
                (enc_id, my_role),
            ).fetchall()

            peer_count = len(peers)
            if peer_count == 0:
                continue

            if my_role == "healer":
                primary_key = "avg_healing"
                reverse_sort = True
            elif my_role == "tank":
                primary_key = "avg_damage_taken"
                reverse_sort = False
            else:
                primary_key = "avg_damage"
                reverse_sort = True

            my_value = my_row[primary_key] or 0
            role_avg = sum(p[primary_key] or 0 for p in peers) / peer_count

            sorted_peers = sorted(peers, key=lambda p: p[primary_key] or 0, reverse=reverse_sort)
            rank = next(
                (i + 1 for i, p in enumerate(sorted_peers) if p["name"].lower() == character_name.lower()),
                peer_count,
            )

            delta_pct = ((my_value - role_avg) / role_avg * 100) if role_avg else 0.0

            results.append({
                "boss_name": boss["name"],
                "encounter_id": enc_id,
                "role": my_role,
                "kills": my_row["kills"],
                "my_value": my_value,
                "role_avg": round(role_avg),
                "delta_pct": round(delta_pct, 1),
                "rank": rank,
                "peer_count": peer_count,
            })

        return results

    def get_healer_role_avg_trend(self) -> list[dict]:
        """Per-raid average healing stats across all healers (for overlay)."""
        conn = self._get_conn()
        rows = conn.execute(
            """SELECT r.raid_date, r.raid_size,
                      AVG(hp.total_healing) as avg_healing,
                      AVG(hp.overheal_percent) as avg_overheal,
                      AVG(hp.active_time_percent) as avg_active_time
               FROM healer_performance hp
               JOIN raids r ON r.id = hp.raid_id
               WHERE r.source = 'guild'
               GROUP BY hp.raid_id
               ORDER BY r.raid_date DESC
               LIMIT 20""",
        ).fetchall()
        return [dict(r) for r in rows]

    def get_tank_role_avg_trend(self) -> list[dict]:
        """Per-raid average tank stats across all tanks (for overlay)."""
        conn = self._get_conn()
        rows = conn.execute(
            """SELECT r.raid_date, r.raid_size,
                      AVG(tp.total_damage_taken) as avg_damage_taken,
                      AVG(tp.mitigation_percent) as avg_mitigation,
                      AVG(tp.active_time_percent) as avg_active_time

               JOIN raids r ON r.id = tp.raid_id
               WHERE r.source = 'guild'
               GROUP BY tp.raid_id
               ORDER BY r.raid_date DESC

        ).fetchall()
        return [dict(r) for r in rows]

    def get_dps_role_avg_trend(self) -> list[dict]:
        """Per-raid average DPS stats across all DPS (for overlay)."""
        conn = self._get_conn()
        rows = conn.execute(
            """SELECT r.raid_date, r.raid_size,

               JOIN raids r ON r.id = dp.raid_id
               WHERE r.source = 'guild'
               GROUP BY dp.raid_id
               ORDER BY r.raid_date DESC
               LIMIT 20""",
        ).fetchall()
        return [dict(r) for r in rows]

    chart: QChart,
    points: list[tuple[datetime, float]],
    name: str,
    x_axis: QDateTimeAxis,
    y_axis: QValueAxis,
):
    """Add a dashed 'Role Avg' overlay line to an existing chart."""
    if not points:
        return
    series = QLineSeries()
    series.setName(name)
    pen = QPen(QColor("#ffffff"))
    pen.setWidth(2)
    pen.setStyle(Qt.PenStyle.DashLine)
    series.setPen(pen)
    for dt, val in points:
        ms = QDateTime(dt).toMSecsSinceEpoch()
        series.append(QPointF(ms, val))
    chart.addSeries(series)
    series.attachAxis(x_axis)
    series.attachAxis(y_axis)

    def _compute_role_comparison(db, name: str, role: str | None) -> dict | None:
        if not role:
            return None
        if role == "healer":
            peers = db.get_healer_insights(min_raids=1)
            if not peers:
                return None
            my_row = next((p for p in peers if p["name"].lower() == name.lower()), None)
            if not my_row:
                return None
            avg_healing = sum(p["avg_healing"] for p in peers) / len(peers)
            avg_overheal = sum(p["avg_overheal"] for p in peers) / len(peers)
            avg_dispels = sum(p.get("total_dispels", 0) for p in peers) / len(peers)
            sorted_peers = sorted(peers, key=lambda p: p["avg_healing"], reverse=True)
            rank = next(i + 1 for i, p in enumerate(sorted_peers) if p["name"].lower() == name.lower())
            return {
                "role_label": "Healer",
                "peer_count": len(peers),
                "rank": rank,
                "metrics": [
                    ("Avg Healing", my_row["avg_healing"], avg_healing, True),
                    ("Avg Overheal %", my_row["avg_overheal"], avg_overheal, False),
                    ("Total Dispels", my_row.get("total_dispels", 0), avg_dispels, True),
                ],
            }
        if role == "tank":
            peers = db.get_tank_mitigation_stats(min_raids=1)
            if not peers:
                return None
            my_row = next((p for p in peers if p["name"].lower() == name.lower()), None)
            if not my_row:
                return None
            avg_mit = sum(p["avg_mitigation"] for p in peers) / len(peers)
            avg_taken = sum(p["avg_damage_taken"] for p in peers) / len(peers)
            sorted_peers = sorted(peers, key=lambda p: p["avg_mitigation"], reverse=True)
            rank = next(i + 1 for i, p in enumerate(sorted_peers) if p["name"].lower() == name.lower())
            return {
                "role_label": "Tank",
                "peer_count": len(peers),
                "rank": rank,
                "metrics": [
                    ("Avg Mitigation %", my_row["avg_mitigation"], avg_mit, True),
                    ("Avg Damage Taken", my_row["avg_damage_taken"], avg_taken, False),
                ],
            }
        peers = db.get_dps_consistency(min_raids=1)
        if not peers:
            return None
        my_row = next((p for p in peers if p["name"].lower() == name.lower()), None)
        if not my_row:
            return None
        avg_damage = sum(p["avg_damage"] for p in peers) / len(peers)
        avg_cons = sum(p["consistency"] for p in peers) / len(peers)
        sorted_peers = sorted(peers, key=lambda p: p["avg_damage"], reverse=True)
        rank = next(i + 1 for i, p in enumerate(sorted_peers) if p["name"].lower() == name.lower())
        return {
            "role_label": "DPS",
            "peer_count": len(peers),
            "rank": rank,
            "metrics": [
                ("Avg Damage", my_row["avg_damage"], avg_damage, True),
                ("Consistency", my_row["consistency"], avg_cons, True),
            ],
        }

    def _populate_role_comparison(self, data: dict | None):
        while self._role_comparison_layout.count():
            item = self._role_comparison_layout.takeAt(0)
            if item.widget():
                item.widget().deleteLater()
        self._role_tiles.clear()

        if not data:
            self._role_comparison_section.setVisible(False)
            return

        self._role_comparison_section.setVisible(True)

        rank_tile = QWidget()
        rank_layout = QVBoxLayout(rank_tile)
        rank_layout.setSpacing(2)
        rank_label = QLabel("Role Rank")
        rank_label.setStyleSheet(f"color: {COLORS['text_dim']}; font-size: 11px;")
        rank_label.setAlignment(Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignCenter)
        rank_val = QLabel(f"{_ordinal(data['rank'])} of {data['peer_count']} {data['role_label']}s")
        rank_val.setStyleSheet(f"color: {COLORS['accent']}; font-size: 16px; font-weight: bold;")
        rank_val.setAlignment(Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignCenter)
        rank_layout.addWidget(rank_label)
        rank_layout.addWidget(rank_val)
        self._role_comparison_layout.addWidget(rank_tile)

        for label, my_val, role_avg, higher_is_better in data["metrics"]:
            tile = QWidget()
            tile_layout = QVBoxLayout(tile)
            tile_layout.setSpacing(2)

            title = QLabel(label)
            title.setStyleSheet(f"color: {COLORS['text_dim']}; font-size: 11px;")
            title.setAlignment(Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignCenter)

            if isinstance(my_val, float) and my_val < 200:
                yours_text = f"{my_val:.1f}"
                avg_text = f"{role_avg:.1f}"
            else:
                yours_text = f"{my_val:,.0f}"
                avg_text = f"{role_avg:,.0f}"

            yours = QLabel(f"You: {yours_text}")
            yours.setStyleSheet(f"color: {COLORS['text']}; font-size: 13px; font-weight: bold;")
            yours.setAlignment(Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignCenter)

            avg_lbl = QLabel(f"Avg: {avg_text}")
            avg_lbl.setStyleSheet(f"color: {COLORS['text_dim']}; font-size: 12px;")
            avg_lbl.setAlignment(Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignCenter)

            delta = ((my_val - role_avg) / role_avg * 100) if role_avg else 0
            good = delta > 0 if higher_is_better else delta < 0
            color = COLORS["success"] if good else COLORS["error"]
            delta_lbl = QLabel(f"{delta:+.1f}%")
            delta_lbl.setStyleSheet(f"color: {color}; font-size: 12px; font-weight: bold;")
            delta_lbl.setAlignment(Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignCenter)

            tile_layout.addWidget(title)
            tile_layout.addWidget(yours)
            tile_layout.addWidget(avg_lbl)
            tile_layout.addWidget(delta_lbl)
            self._role_comparison_layout.addWidget(tile)

        self._role_comparison_layout.addStretch()

    def _on_profile_error(self, error_msg: str):
        self._refresh_btn.setEnabled(True)
        self._progress.setVisible(False)
        self.status_message.emit(f"Failed to load profile: {error_msg}")
        char_name = self._char_name_input.text().strip()
        if char_name:
            self._load_trends(char_name)"}

classified_spans.text:
This is very doable. The API already gives us `begincast` events — we just skip them everywhere right now. Here's the picture:

**Auto shot clipping detection**: WCL returns both `begincast` and `cast` events in the Casts dataType. A clipped auto shot is a `begincast` (spell ID 75) with no matching `cast` event before the next `begincast`. The data is already flowing through `get_cast_events_paginated` — we just need to stop throwing away `begincast` events for hunters.

**Expansion ideas for the My Character dashboard:**

1. **Hunter auto shot clip rate** — `clipped / total_begincast` per boss, with trend over raids. Top hunters clip <5%. This directly fits the boss comparison table pattern.

2. **Healer cancelled casts** — same `begincast`/`cast` pairing for Greater Heal, Healing Wave etc. Shows triage decision-making (cancelling a heal because someone else topped the target). Good cancelled heals are a *skill* signal.

3. **Cast efficiency per role** — ratio of completed casts to started casts across all abilities. Movement-heavy fights will naturally have more cancels.
